title: Annual Percentage Yield Schedule for Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
### Base yield by balance band

Each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts carries a base annual percentage yield ladder, stated as a band floor in USD and the yield percent that floor turns on, together with the band method that governs how the ladder applies and the end-of-day balance below which a day earns no interest.

| Tier | Band floors and base annual percentage yield | Band method | Minimum end-of-day balance to earn interest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 0.00 USD and above: 0.05 percent | tiered | 10.00 USD |
| Statement Savings | 0.00 USD and above: 0.05 percent; 10000.00 USD and above: 0.10 percent | tiered | 10.00 USD |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.00 USD and above: 0.25 percent | tiered | 0.00 USD |
| Money Market Account | 0.00 USD and above: 0.10 percent; 2500.00 USD and above: 0.50 percent; 25000.00 USD and above: 1.00 percent; 100000.00 USD and above: 1.50 percent | tiered | 0.00 USD |
| Premier Money Market | 0.00 USD and above: 0.25 percent; 10000.00 USD and above: 1.25 percent; 50000.00 USD and above: 2.00 percent; 250000.00 USD and above: 2.50 percent | blended | 0.00 USD |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.00 USD and above: 1.50 percent; 100000.00 USD and above: 2.75 percent; 500000.00 USD and above: 3.25 percent | blended | 0.00 USD |

### The two band methods

Under the tiered method the whole balance earns the yield of the highest band floor the balance reaches. Under the blended method each slice of balance lying between two consecutive floors earns the yield of its own band.

### Worked illustration of the two methods

Take a hypothetical end-of-day balance of 60000.00 USD.

On Money Market Account, whose method is tiered, 60000.00 USD reaches the 25000.00 USD floor and not the 100000.00 USD floor, so the whole 60000.00 USD earns 1.00 percent.

On Premier Money Market, whose method is blended, the same 60000.00 USD is cut at the floors of the ladder: the first 10000.00 USD earns 0.25 percent, the slice from 10000.00 USD to 50000.00 USD earns 1.25 percent, and the slice from 50000.00 USD to 60000.00 USD earns 2.00 percent. The 250000.00 USD floor is not reached, so no part of the balance earns 2.50 percent.

### Minimum balance to earn interest

The last column is the end-of-day balance below which a day earns no interest at all. It is 10.00 USD on Starter Savings and Statement Savings, and 0.00 USD on the other four tiers.
